entries.title: Children of Morta
entries.definitive_edition: Children of Morta Complete Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Complete Edition with Ancient Spirits and Paws & Claws
primary.why: The Windows PC version has the complete edition/DLC route, the best capture/input flexibility, and no sourced platform-exclusive content missing from PC. Console and mobile routes are valid but not better for archival capture.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Children of Morta: Complete Edition on Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, or Microsoft Store for Windows PC, or buy the base game plus Ancient Spirits and Paws & Claws DLC separately.

entries.remaster_caveats: Complete Edition is a content bundle, not a remaster. Paws & Claws was a charity DLC/add-on and Ancient Spirits adds a playable fighter and systems content.
